hero.title: PDKS - Personel Devam Kontrol Sistemi
hero.text: İdenfit PDKS, hem yazılım hem de donanım çözümlerini bir arada sunar. Böylece ekstra operasyon maliyetlerini sizin için en aza indirirken fiyat avantajınızı korur.

sections.title: Neden idenfit
sections.text: PDKS yani “Personel devam kontrol sistemi” personelin belirlenen geçiş ve kontrol noktalarından giriş çıkışlarını, PDKS cihaz ve donanımları aracılığı ile kayıt altına alan otomasyon sistemlerdir. İşlenen kayıtlar online olarak PKDS yazılımına iletilerek analiz edilebilir ve analiz sonucunda personelin işe giriş çıkış saatleri, mesaileri ve izinleri gibi devamlılığıyla ilgili bilgiler PDKS ile sağlıklı bir şekilde kayıt altında tutulur. Böylece ay sonunda performans, puantaj ve buna bağlı maaş hesapları kolaylıkla yapılır.

sections.title: Turnike Geçiş Sistemleri
sections.text:
İdenfit PDKS sistemi ile turnike ya da geçiş noktalarına tanımlanan sistem sayesinde kimlik doğrulama ve çalışanların gerçek zamanlı giriş-çıkış takibi kolaylıkla yapılabilir.

idenfit PDKS programı sayesinde turnikelere kartlı geçiş, yüz okuma veya parmak izi okuma sistemleri kurularak geçişler tanımlanabilir.

“Tüm raporlamaları alacağınız yazılımımız entegre çalıştığımız PDKS cihazlarıyla uyumlu çalışır.”

sections.title: Kart Okuyucular
sections.text:
İdenfit mobil PDKS çözümleri ile turnike, kapı ya da giriş-çıkış noktalarında yazılıma bağlı kart okuyucular ve cihazlara tanımlanmış çalışana özel kartlar sayesinde işletmenizde PDKS uygulayabilirsiniz.

Sistem, personel kart okuyucuların çalışan kartını okuttuğunda personel kart ID’lerinin zaman damgalı olarak yazılıma aktarılmasıyla çalışır. Kart okuyucu ile kayıt altına alınan bilgileri İdenfit PDKS Yazılımı ile değerlendirerek raporlayabilir ve çalışanlarınızın takibini ve puantaj hesaplamasını kolayca yapabilirsiniz.

sections.title: Parmak İzi Okuyucular
sections.text:
Her işletmenin PDKS ihtiyacı birbirinden farklıdır. Kimi işletme için kart okuma sistemi daha uygun olurken bir diğer işletme için parmak izi okuyucu sistemi daha verimli olabilir. İdenfit PDKS çözümlerinden parmak izi okuma ve tanımlama sistemi ile parmak izi okutarak kontrol noktalarından güvenle giriş – çıkış işlemi yapılabilir.

Parmak izi okuyucu ile kayıt altına alınan bilgileri İdenfit PDKS Yazılımı ile değerlendirerek raporlayabilir ve çalışanlarınızın puantaj hesaplaması işlemlerini kolayca yapabilirsiniz.

sections.title: Yüz Tanıma Sistemleri
sections.text:
Yüz tanıma sistemleri, PDKS ve geçiş kontrol sistemleri için tasarlanmış biyometrik okuyuculu takip sistemleridir. Yüksek doğrulama oranı, düşük hata payı, hızlı tanımlama özelliği ve temassız hijyenik kullanımı ile yüz tanıma sistemleri özellikle kart okuyuculara ya da parmak izi kullanımına uygun olmayan sektörlerde en pratik ve güvenli takip çözümlerinin başında gelir.

Yüz tanıma sistemleri ile kayıt altına alınan bilgileri İdenfit PDKS Yazılımı ile değerlendirerek raporlayabilir ve çalışan takibini kolaylıkla gerçekleştirebilirsiniz.

sections.text:
Çalışanlar telefonlarına indirdikleri İdenfit mobil PDKS uygulamasıyla beacon teknolojisi, GPS, NFC, QR kod gibi teknolojilerle kimlik ve lokasyon doğrulaması yapabilirler. Ayrıca mobil uygulama üzerinden fazla mesai ve izin taleplerini de gerçekleştirebilirler.

Mobil cihaz kullanımıyla, idenfit personel devam kontrol sistemi uygulaması sayesinde çalışanların işe giriş-çıkış bilgileri, izin, vardiya, mola kayıtları ve fazla mesaileri kayıt altında tutulur.

sections.title: Why Idenfit Time and Attendance System?
sections.text:
Time and attendance systems are used to track and monitor employees’ work schedule especially when they start and stop work. A time and attendance system enables an employer to review their employees working hours, late arrivals, early departures, time taken on breaks and absenteeism.

The automated time and attendance systems require employees to touch or swipe to verify their identity and record their working hours as they enter or leave the work area. This self – service system also encourages employees to take their own responsibilities about requesting sick leave, holiday or overtime and managing their own time-off balances.

Idenfit cloud-based software interconnected with hardwares offers easy solutions for managing time and attendance especially tracking and reporting employees’ arrivals, shifts, sick leaves, overtime and holidays without a mess.

sections.title: Turnstile Access Control
sections.text:
Turnstile access control systems are used to restrict access, provide security and control people traffic. They bring order to crowds in many public facilities and provide security to high-risk areas.

Idenfit turnstile access control systems allow users to identify and track employees in combination with various identification sensors, such as intelligent card reader, fingerprint readers and facial recognition systems. Idenfit software can be easily integrated with all recognition devices.

sections.title: Card Readers
sections.text:
Card reader devices can be placed in the access points and used for both access control and tracking the arrivals and departures of the employees. Card reader system is based on using ID cards to clock in and out.

Card readers are commonly used to track employee working hours, late arrivals, absenteeism, breaks and leaves. The collected datas on Idenfit software help users generate payroll reports more accurately. Users can check data history as well and get reports about previous records of the time schedule of the employees.

sections.title: Biometric Fingerprint Attendance System
sections.text: Every company is different and therefore they may need different attendance solutions for employee identification and tracking. One of the most popular methods is using fingerprint scanners and readers as a time and attendance system. Using fingerprint devices for recording employees time and attendance is currently the most accurate and cost effective solution available among biometric systems.

sections.title: Biometric Facial Recognition Systems
sections.text:
Facial recognition systems are used for the process of identifying or verifying the identity of an employee using their face. It captures, analyzes and compares patterns based on the person’s facial details.

Facial recognition systems work as the facial features of the employee are scanned and identified as 3D in the system with the high-resolution cameras and identified reference points are converted into numerical data. These verified data is exported from the device to the software then can be used as a meaningful identification system.

Facial recognition systems guarantee you accuracy, security, availability, ease of use, full integration to devices, usability, and hygiene issues.

sections.title: BAB Beacon (Bluetooth)
sections.text:
Bab bluetooth tracker and access point implementation systems allow users to track employees & objects and monitor employees’ working hours, late arrivals, early departures, time taken on breaks and absenteeism. Users can check data history as well and get reports about previous records of location and time.

Bab app also gives users the ability to control access remotely – remarkably quick and reliable access. Users can restrict or share access and manage all the door access permissions for anyone from anywhere.

sections.title: Mobile Attendance System
sections.text:
Mobile time and attendance systems are low cost and easy to implement since many of the employees have their own smartphones. This system – uses GPS technology which works on cell phones – also makes location tracking easy, legal and accurate.

Idenfit Time and Attendance System allows users to use their mobile phones as the company entrance ID card with Idenfit Time App that can be easily downloaded for both IOS and Android.

Idenfit Time App includes beacon, gps, nfc, qr technologies for identification and location tracking. Employees can choose the appropriate technology, easily verify their IDs and locations with their phones and also fill in the leave and overtime request forms on Idenfit Time App. The collected datas on Idenfit Time App help users generate payroll reports more accurately.

sections.title: Waarom idenfit
sections.text: PDKS, oftewel “Personeels aanwezigheidscontrole systeem”, is een automatiseringssysteem dat de in- en uitgangen van personeel via de vastgestelde toegang- en controlepunten registreert met behulp van PDKS apparaten en hardware. De verwerkte registraties kunnen online worden verzonden naar de PKDS software voor analyse, en op basis van de analyse worden gegevens over de in- en uitgaande tijden van personeel, overuren en verlof op een gezonde manier geregistreerd met PDKS. Hierdoor kunnen aan het einde van de maand prestaties, aanwezigheidsregistratie en de bijbehorende salarisberekeningen eenvoudig worden uitgevoerd.

sections.title: Toegangssystemen
sections.text:
Met het PDKS systeem van Idenfit kan de identificatie en real-time in- en uitgangen van werknemers eenvoudig worden gevolgd via het systeem dat aan de toegangspoorten of -punten is toegewezen.

Met het PDKS programma van idenfit kunnen toegangssystemen zoals kaartlezers, gezichtsherkenning of vingerafdruklezers worden geïnstalleerd voor toegang.

“De software waarmee u alle rapportages ontvangt, werkt compatibel met de PDKS apparaten waarmee wij geïntegreerd zijn.”

sections.title: Kaartlezers
sections.text:
Met de mobiele PDKS-oplossingen van Idenfit kunt u PDKS toepassen in uw bedrijf met behulp van software-gebaseerde kaartlezers en speciaal voor werknemers gedefinieerde kaarten bij toegangspoorten, deuren of in- en uitgangen.

Het systeem werkt door de tijdstempels van de personeelskaart-ID’s naar de software te verzenden wanneer de personeelskaart wordt gescand door de kaartlezer. U kunt de gegevens die met de kaartlezer zijn geregistreerd evalueren met de Idenfit PDKS Software en eenvoudig de opvolging en aanwezigheidsregistratie van uw werknemers uitvoeren.

sections.title: Vingerafdruklezers
sections.text:
De PDKS-behoeften van elk bedrijf zijn verschillend. Voor sommige bedrijven kan een kaartleessysteem geschikter zijn, terwijl voor andere bedrijven een vingerafdrukleessysteem efficiënter kan zijn. Met het vingerafdrukleessysteem van Idenfit kunnen in- en uitgangen veilig worden uitgevoerd door vingerafdrukken te scannen bij controlepunten.

U kunt de gegevens die met de vingerafdruklezer zijn geregistreerd evalueren met de Idenfit PDKS Software en eenvoudig de aanwezigheidsregistratie van uw werknemers uitvoeren.

sections.title: Gezichtsherkenningssystemen
sections.text:
Gezichtsherkenningssystemen zijn biometrische volgsystemen die zijn ontworpen voor PDKS en toegang controle systemen. Met een hoge verificatiegraad, lage foutmarge, snelle identificatie en contactloze hygiënische toepassing behoren gezichtsherkenningssystemen tot de meest praktische en veilige oplossingen voor opvolging, vooral in sectoren waar kaartlezers of vingerafdrukgebruik niet geschikt zijn.

U kunt de gegevens die met gezichtsherkenningssystemen zijn geregistreerd evalueren met de Idenfit PDKS Software en eenvoudig de opvolging van werknemers uitvoeren.

De BAB-productlijn, die oplossingen voor toegang en opvolging biedt zoals beacon, reader, wandlezer en mobiele toegangstoepassing, stelt u in staat om personen of objecten eenvoudig te volgen en hun opvolging te beheren met behulp van bluetooth-technologie.

Met BAB kunt u de in- en uitgangen van uw werknemers controleren en hun toegang beheren. Zelfs als u zich op afstand met uw mobiele apparaat bevindt, kunt u veilige toegang delen of beperken voor specifieke tijdsintervallen en werknemers.

Aan de PDKS-kant kunt u, indien gewenst, ook terugwerkende kracht aanvragen en historische gegevens uit het systeem ophalen.

sections.title: Why Idenfit Time and Attendance System?
sections.text:
Time and attendance systems are used to track and monitor employees’ work schedule especially when they start and stop work. A time and attendance system enables an employer to review their employees working hours, late arrivals, early departures, time taken on breaks and absenteeism.

The automated time and attendance systems require employees to touch or swipe to verify their identity and record their working hours as they enter or leave the work area. This self - service system also encourages employees to take their own responsibilities about requesting sick leave, holiday or overtime and managing their own time-off balances.

Idenfit cloud-based software interconnected with hardwares offers easy solutions for managing time and attendance especially tracking and reporting employees’ arrivals, shifts, sick leaves, overtime and holidays without a mess.

sections.title: Turnstile Access Control
sections.text:
Turnstile access control systems are used to restrict access, provide security and control people traffic. They bring order to crowds in many public facilities and provide security to high-risk areas.

Idenfit turnstile access control systems allow users to identify and track employees in combination with various identification sensors, such as intelligent card reader, fingerprint readers and facial recognition systems. Idenfit software can be easily integrated with all recognition devices.2

sections.title: Card Readers
sections.text:
Card reader devices can be placed in the access points and used for both access control and tracking the arrivals and departures of the employees. Card reader system is based on using ID cards to clock in and out.

Card readers are commonly used to track employee working hours, late arrivals, absenteeism, breaks and leaves. The collected datas on Idenfit software help users generate payroll reports more accurately. Users can check data history as well and get reports about previous records of the time schedule of the employees.

sections.title: Biometric Fingerprint Attendance System
sections.text: Every company is different and therefore they may need different attendance solutions for employee identification and tracking. One of the most popular methods is using fingerprint scanners and readers as a time and attendance system. Using fingerprint devices for recording employees time and attendance is currently the most accurate and cost effective solution available among biometric systems.

sections.title: Biometric Facial Recognition Systems
sections.text:
Facial recognition systems are used for the process of identifying or verifying the identity of an employee using their face. It captures, analyzes and compares patterns based on the person’s facial details.

Facial recognition systems work as the facial features of the employee are scanned and identified as 3D in the system with the high-resolution cameras and identified reference points are converted into numerical data. These verified data is exported from the device to the software then can be used as a meaningful identification system.

Facial recognition systems guarantee you accuracy, security, availability, ease of use, full integration to devices, usability, and hygiene issues.

sections.title: BAB Beacon (Bluetooth)

Bab bluetooth tracker and access point implementation systems allow users to track employees & objects and monitor employees’ working hours, late arrivals, early departures, time taken on breaks and absenteeism. Users can check data history as well and get reports about previous records of location and time.

Bab app also gives users the ability to control access remotely – remarkably quick and reliable access. Users can restrict or share access and manage all the door access permissions for anyone from anywhere.

hero.title: Leave Management
hero.text: Idenfit has all the features you will ever need to manage your employee leave.

sections.title: Leave management & calendar
sections.text:
https://idenfit.com/request-online-presentation/

Idenfit leave management system allows you to stop all time-off abuses and implement company-wide leave policy. You can add your own leave types, make exceptions for individual employees and groups for using leave requests and approval.

Idenfit let users monitor leave requests and approvals annually, monthly and weekly. You can review any leave requests on the user-friendly dashboard, add a new one or edit it. It is also possible to define and add leave types to systems for the users.

sections.title: Leave requests
sections.text:
It is very easy and flexible to manage employees’ leave with Idenfit. On Idenfit, managers can assign leave approvals on the behalf of other employees. Beside employees have many options about leave management requests while managing their leave process.

  • Employees can request for half day, full day or time-based leaves and edit their leave requests when their plans change.
  • Employees can easily see the current balances of all their leave entitlements and check the leave requests status whether they are approved or pending.
  • Idenfit allows employees to upload documents for sick leaves or any official papers to claim need of leave.
  • Employees can fill in the customized fields when requesting for leave.
  • Gender, age or status based types of leave can be created and added to system.

sections.title: Smart leave management
sections.text: Idenfit leave management allow users to set different sets of company holidays for each location of your global offices. Individual employees can have their own set of holidays based on their status, age and gender etc. Weekly working hours and days-off can be set differently based on the location, department, position and even at an employee status. When holidays are added or changed, duration of all leave requests that were already applied will be recalculated automatically.

sections.title: Leave approvals
sections.text:
Managers and authorised people can approve or reject leaves that employees create or edit with Idenfit. You can create automatic leave approval workflows with approvers with their titles and positions.

On Idenfit you can attach various approval paths for different leave types at the employee level. For example, sick leave can have one approval path yet for vacation users can create another approval path.

If leave request is not approved within a set time interval, approval can be escalated to a different manager and they can approve the request. On the other hand, you can set backup users as approving managers. Approval request will be seen by the backup manager when the main manager is not able to approve. You can also add only HR managers to approve or reject any leave requests.

sections.title: Flexible reports
sections.text: Idenfit cares about being user friendly and knows how important reporting in the hr departments when it comes to leave management. Users can create reports and download them in Excel and PDF formats without stress. While reporting, users can use filtering feature to reach out the exact issues they want to cover about employees, locations, departments leave approvals.

faq.question: How can annual leave planning be made more efficient?
faq.answer: Idenfit simplifies leave planning by automatically calculating annual leave balances based on employee entitlements.

faq.question: Why should leave management be handled digitally?
faq.answer: Manual tracking leads to time loss and a higher risk of errors. With digital leave systems, all requests, approvals, leave history, and different types of leave can be managed through a single screen and calendar view.

faq.question: What advantages does Idenfit’s leave module offer as a leave management system?
faq.answer: It consolidates all leave types into a centralized structure, speeds up approval workflows, and eliminates paperwork. Idenfit also allows for the configuration of custom leave types with specific restrictions and conditions.

faq.question: Is Idenfit sufficient for HR leave management?
faq.answer: Yes, it is. With flexible rules, multi-level approval workflows, and parameterized leave types, Idenfit provides a powerful solution for HR teams.

Idenfit has provided us with the ability to handle document tracking and leave management quickly and smoothly in a fully digital environment.

hero.title: Verlofbeheer
hero.text: Idenfit heeft alle functies die je ooit nodig zult hebben om het verlof van je werknemers te beheren.

sections.title: Verlofbeheer & kalender
sections.text:
https://idenfit.com/request-online-presentation/

Het verlofbeheersysteem van Idenfit stelt je in staat om alle misbruik van verlof te stoppen en een bedrijfsbrede verlofbeleid te implementeren. Je kunt je eigen verloftypes toevoegen, uitzonderingen maken voor individuele werknemers en groepen voor het indienen van verlofaanvragen en goedkeuring.

Idenfit laat gebruikers verlofaanvragen en goedkeuringen jaarlijks, maandelijks en wekelijks volgen. Je kunt elke verlofaanvraag bekijken op het gebruiksvriendelijke dashboard, een nieuwe aanvraag toevoegen of deze bewerken. Het is ook mogelijk om verloftypes te definiëren en toe te voegen aan systemen voor de gebruikers.

sections.title: Verlofaanvragen
sections.text:
Het is heel eenvoudig en flexibel om het verlof van werknemers te beheren met Idenfit. Bij Idenfit kunnen managers verlofgoedkeuringen toekennen namens andere werknemers. Daarnaast hebben werknemers veel opties met betrekking tot verlofbeheer aanvragen terwijl ze hun verlofproces beheren.

  • Werknemers kunnen aanvragen voor een halve dag, een volle dag of tijdgebonden verlof indienen en hun verlofaanvragen bewerken wanneer hun plannen veranderen.
  • Werknemers kunnen eenvoudig de huidige saldi van al hun verlofrechten zien en de status van de verlofaanvragen controleren, of ze zijn goedgekeurd of in behandeling.
  • Idenfit stelt werknemers in staat om documenten voor ziekteverlof of andere officiële papieren te uploaden om de noodzaak van verlof te claimen.
  • Werknemers kunnen de aangepaste velden invullen bij het aanvragen van verlof.
  • Verloftypes op basis van geslacht, leeftijd of status kunnen worden aangemaakt en aan het systeem worden toegevoegd.

sections.title: Slim verlofbeheer
sections.text: Idenfit verlofbeheer stelt gebruikers in staat om verschillende sets van bedrijfsfeesten voor elke locatie van je wereldwijde kantoren in te stellen. Individuele werknemers kunnen hun eigen set vakantiedagen hebben op basis van hun status, leeftijd en geslacht, enzovoort. Wekelijkse werkuren en vrije dagen kunnen anders worden ingesteld op basis van locatie, afdeling, functie en zelfs de status van een werknemer. Wanneer vakantiedagen worden toegevoegd of gewijzigd, wordt de duur van alle verlofaanvragen die al zijn ingediend automatisch herberekend.

sections.title: Verlofgoedkeuringen
sections.text:
Managers en bevoegde personen kunnen verlof goedkeuren of afwijzen dat werknemers aanmaken of bewerken met Idenfit. Je kunt automatische verlofgoedkeuringsworkflows creëren met goedkeurders met hun titels en posities.

Bij Idenfit kun je verschillende goedkeuringspaden voor verschillende verloftypes op werknemersniveau koppelen. Bijvoorbeeld, ziekteverlof kan één goedkeuringspad hebben, terwijl voor vakantiegebruikers een ander goedkeuringspad kan worden gecreëerd.

Als een verlofaanvraag niet binnen een bepaalde tijdsperiode wordt goedgekeurd, kan de goedkeuring worden geëscaleerd naar een andere manager en kan deze de aanvraag goedkeuren. Aan de andere kant kun je back-up gebruikers instellen als goedkeuringsmanagers. De goedkeuringsaanvraag zal door de back-upmanager worden gezien wanneer de hoofdmanager niet in staat is om goed te keuren. Je kunt ook alleen HR-managers toevoegen om verlofaanvragen goed te keuren of af te wijzen.

sections.title: Flexibele rapporten
sections.text: Idenfit geeft om gebruiksvriendelijkheid en weet hoe belangrijk rapportage is in de HR-afdelingen als het gaat om verlofbeheer. Gebruikers kunnen rapporten maken en deze zonder stress downloaden in Excel- en PDF-formaten. Tijdens het rapporteren kunnen gebruikers de filterfunctie gebruiken om de exacte kwesties te bereiken die ze willen behandelen over werknemers, locaties, afdelingen en verlofgoedkeuringen.

faq.question: Hoe kan de planning van jaarlijks verlof efficiënter worden gemaakt?
faq.answer: Idenfit vereenvoudigt de verlofplanning door automatisch de jaarlijkse verlofsaldi te berekenen op basis van de rechten van werknemers.

faq.question: Waarom moet verlofbeheer digitaal worden afgehandeld?
faq.answer: Handmatige tracking leidt tot tijdverlies en een hoger risico op fouten. Met digitale verlofsystemen kunnen alle aanvragen, goedkeuringen, verlofgeschiedenis en verschillende soorten verlof via één scherm en kalenderweergave worden beheerd.

faq.question: Welke voordelen biedt de verlofmodule van Idenfit als verlofbeheersysteem?
faq.answer: Het consolideert alle verloftypes in een gecentraliseerde structuur, versnelt goedkeuringsworkflows en elimineert papierwerk. Idenfit stelt ook de configuratie van aangepaste verloftypes met specifieke beperkingen en voorwaarden mogelijk.

faq.question: Is Idenfit voldoende voor HR-verlofbeheer?
faq.answer: Ja, dat is het. Met flexibele regels, goedkeuringsworkflows op meerdere niveaus en geparameteriseerde verloftypes biedt Idenfit een krachtige oplossing voor HR-teams.

hero.title: Performance Appraisal Module
hero.text: You can easily monitor and manage your organization, team or individual performance to achieve your goals and competencies with Idenfit performance management system

sections.title: Set Goals and Competencies
sections.text:
Idenfit performance appraisal module allows you to set specific, measurable, and time-bound goals (kpi) and competencies on the dynamic dashboard

By using Idenfit performance appraisal, you can easily measure each task completion and how effective the task is done. You can also monitor which skills are essential to complete the tasks and finally you can review the quality of task completion.

You can define competencies in different categories such as corporate, professional, social, leadership and organizational skills; as well as the goals you can set like sales targets, customer satisfaction level, etc… under KPI. You can also create and add different goals and competencies that you want to measure, if they are not already defined.

sections.title: 360 Degree Performance Appraisal
sections.text:
Idenfit performance appraisal allows you to measure the individual staff and team performance effectively with KPI and competences. You can have an insight about their contribution on every objectives as well as organizational level.

360 degrees performance appraisal means that an employee can be evaluated by his/her peers, managers
(i.e. superior), subordinates – anyone who works with the employee and can provide valuable insights and information or feedback regarding the job performance of the employee.

With Idenfit, you can measure the four integral components of 360 degree performance appraisal which are self appraisal, peer appraisal, superior’s appraisal and subordinate’s appraisal.

sections.title: Performance Review & Quality Rating
sections.text:
Performance management results are highly important in the organizations because it is the determining factor in an employee’s wage rise and promotions and also it can evaluate an employee’s skills and strengths accurately.

Idenfit helps the employees to get performance review and quality rating from their managers for every task completed.

sections.title: Implement result based training
sections.text: Beyond performance appraisal, Idenfit also allows you to take action according to the results of performance review. In the time-bound projects, the performance results are often used for planning training and development or in the best cases they are used in making administrative decisions, such as pay or promotion.

faq.question: What is the Idenfit performance evaluation scale?
faq.answer: Idenfit offers a customized, goal-based performance and competency evaluation system tailored to your organization. Performance evaluation scales can be personalized based on KPIs and defined competency groups.

faq.question: Which performance evaluation methods does Idenfit use?
faq.answer: Idenfit goes beyond traditional methods by supporting KPI-based evaluations at set intervals and 360-degree performance evaluation. It also allows for one-on-one assessments.

idenfit işe alım modülüyle İK departmanı olarak, işe alım sürecini oluşturan

sections.title: Görüşme puan kartları
sections.text:
idenfit işe alım modülüyle insan kaynakları departmanları;

  • İş ilanının farklı kanallar aracılığıyla çıkılması,
  • Özgeçmişlerin filtrelenip ilgili departmana atanması,
  • Seçilen özgeçmişler ile ön görüşmelerin yapılması,
  • Görüşme sonuçlarının görüşme puan kartları üzerinden değerlendirilmesi,
  • Olumlu geçen adaylar için ikinci görüşme ile ilgili departmanlarla takvim oluşturulması,
  • Anlaşma sağlanması durumunda onboarding sürecine yönlendirilmesi,

idenfit işe alım modülü, dinamik özellikleriyle işe alım sürecinde baştan sona elde edilen tüm verileri aynı panelde bulmanızı ve değişiklikler, eklemeler yapmanızı sağlayacak şekilde tasarlanmıştır. Çek - taşı - bırak özelliğiyle paneli kolaylıkla yönetirsiniz.Panelde dilediğiniz menüyü oluşturabilir ve işe alım süreçlerini kategorilere ayırabilirsiniz. Görüşme yapılan ve olumlu adayları farklı başlıklar altında listeleyebilir ya da olumsuz adaylar için blacklist oluşturarak, görüşmesi olumsuz sonuçlanan kişilerle tekrar zaman kaybetmezsiniz.

faq.question: İşe alım süreci nasıl işler?
faq.answer: İşe alım süreci açık pozisyonun belirlenmesiyle başlar. Ardından iş ilanı hazırlanır, aday başvuruları alınır, özgeçmişler incelenir ve uygun görülen adaylarla görüşmeler yapılır. Görüşmelerin ardından olumlu adaylar bir sonraki aşamaya geçirilir.

faq.question: İşe alım süreç haritası nedir?
faq.answer: İşe alım süreç haritası, bir adayın başvuru yaptığı andan işe başladığı ana kadar geçirdiği adımların görselleştirilmiş halidir. İlan oluşturma, başvuru toplama, mülakat, değerlendirme ve teklif aşamaları bu haritada yer alır.

faq.question: İşe alım süreci ne kadar sürer?
faq.answer: İşe alım süresini pozisyonun niteliği, başvuru yoğunluğu ve şirketin iç dinamikleri belirler.

faq.question: İşe alım süreci aşamaları nelerdir?
faq.answer: İş ilanı yayınlama, başvuruları alma, ön eleme, mülakatlar, testler ve değerlendirme, teklif verme ve onboarding sürecidir.

faq.question: İşe alım sürecinde hangi testler uygulanır?
faq.answer: Adayların yetkinliklerini ölçmek için kişilik envanterleri, teknik bilgi testleri, vaka analizleri ve yetenek testleri kullanılabilir.

faq.question: İşe alım süreci nasıl olmalı?
faq.answer: İşe alım süreci şeffaf, düzenli ve aday deneyimini önemseyen bir yapıda olmalıdır.

hero.title: Offboarding Module
hero.text: You can manage, track and report employee offboarding process accurately with Idenfit.

sections.title: Complete offboarding checklist step by step
sections.text:
It is always sad to see departure of an employee but it is something inevitable in the organizations. Managing the offboarding process smoothly can give companies valuable insights and leave a positive impression of your company on the employee who says goodbye.

Idenfit allows you to plan and implement stress-free offboarding firmly with checklists to ensure compliance and automation to help you focus on the person, not the transaction.

Idenfit sends automatic notifications to admins, managers, and others so users can be sure that all process is checked and employee departure is secure, helpful and thoughtful.

sections.title: Make offboarding process less stressful and more useful
sections.text:
Employees want to know about their last paychecks, benefits coverage, and many more stressful issues while leaving. Idenfit helps reduce the stress and eliminate follow-up calls and e-mails by answering common questions on the spot and making the exit process simple and clear. Employees feel valuable that helps having positive feelings on both sides and protect the organization’s reputation.

Companies can learn many things during the offboarding process of an employee. Offboarding can be a learning path for the organization and give insight into the better employee experience.

Idenfit offboarding module has powerful reporting features that allows users to see what is the reason behind turnover, using various metrics like employee performance, working periods, reason for departure and more common threads that might be sending employees away.

faq.question: What is the offboarding module?
faq.answer: The idenfit offboarding module helps you manage the employee exit process step-by-step, ensuring it runs smoothly, predictably, and with minimal stress for both the employee and the business.

faq.question: What are the benefits of the Offboarding module?
faq.answer: It enables you to manage the entire process from a single panel — notifying all departments in real time, tracking asset returns, generating reports, and analyzing turnover rates to make improvements.

faq.question: How does the Offboarding module support brand image?
faq.answer: By handling the process in an organized, transparent, and respectful way, it leaves a positive impression on departing employees and strengthens your company’s employer brand.

faq.question: What types of documents can be uploaded to an electronic document management system?

sections.title: Manage the expenses in a real-time from mobile!
Don’t get lost between spendings!
sections.text:
With the expenses module,

  • You can capture expenses in real-time from your admin profile.
  • Employees can upload the expenses by taking a photo of the bill (if they have) that they did out of the company.
  • This module can assign the manager for expenses if the employee needs consent.
  • With multiple filtering features, the desired expenditure can be found on the system without losing time.
  • Manage your expenses and expenditures with Idenfit.

sections.title: Separate the advance and subsistence from expenses
sections.text:
Categorizing the expenses by the source of payment helps you to become more systematic. Because of the expenses type and list are separated, you can see them noncomplex.

Also, you can determine the subsistence for your employees and they can use it. Use the advance part to help payroll preparation which provides information on the amount of the advances.

faq.question: Can Idenfit be used as an expense management system?
faq.answer: Yes, it can. With Idenfit, both internal and external company expenses can be tracked in real time, and document submission and approval workflows can be managed easily within the system.

faq.question: Why should expense management processes be digitalized?
faq.answer: Manually tracked expenses increase the risk of errors and consume valuable time. Digital expense management solutions offer speed, transparency, and simplified auditing processes.

faq.question: Is it possible to track expenses without using an expense management program?
faq.answer: Yes, it is possible—but using a dedicated expense management application allows you to centralize advances, travel allowances, and expense documents in a single panel, making the process significantly more efficient and practical.

faq.question: Can all expense management processes be handled from a single application?
faq.answer: Yes. Idenfit serves as a complete expense management tool, enabling end-to-end control over advances, travel allowances, expense reports, and approval workflows—all from a single dashboard.

sections.title: Beheer de onkosten in realtime vanaf mobiel!
Verdwaal niet tussen uitgaven!
sections.text:
Met de onkostenmodule,

  • Kun je onkosten in realtime vastleggen vanuit je admin-profiel.
  • Werknemers kunnen de onkosten uploaden door een foto van de rekening (als ze die hebben) te maken van de uitgaven die ze buiten het bedrijf hebben gedaan.
  • Deze module kan de manager voor onkosten toewijzen als de werknemer toestemming nodig heeft.
  • Met meerdere filterfuncties kan de gewenste uitgave in het systeem worden gevonden zonder tijd te verliezen.
  • Beheer je onkosten en uitgaven met Idenfit.

sections.title: Scheiding van voorschotten en vergoedingen van onkosten
sections.text:
Het categoriseren van de onkosten op basis van de betalingsbron helpt je om systematischer te worden. Omdat de onkostentypes en lijsten gescheiden zijn, kun je ze eenvoudig bekijken.

Daarnaast kun je de vergoedingen voor je werknemers bepalen en kunnen zij deze gebruiken. Gebruik het voorschotgedeelte om de salarisadministratie te helpen, wat informatie biedt over het bedrag van de voorschotten.

faq.question: Kan Idenfit worden gebruikt als een onkostenbeheersysteem?
faq.answer: Ja, dat kan. Met Idenfit kunnen zowel interne als externe bedrijfskosten in realtime worden gevolgd, en documentindiening en goedkeuringsworkflows kunnen eenvoudig binnen het systeem worden beheerd.

faq.question: Waarom moeten onkostenbeheersprocessen gedigitaliseerd worden?
faq.answer: Handmatig bijgehouden onkosten verhogen het risico op fouten en verbruiken waardevolle tijd. Digitale onkostenbeheersoplossingen bieden snelheid, transparantie en vereenvoudigde auditprocessen.

faq.question: Is het mogelijk om onkosten te volgen zonder een onkostenbeheersprogramma te gebruiken?
faq.answer: Ja, dat is mogelijk—maar het gebruik van een speciale onkostenbeheertoepassing stelt je in staat om voorschotten, reiskostenvergoedingen en onkostendocumenten in één paneel te centraliseren, waardoor het proces aanzienlijk efficiënter en praktischer wordt.

faq.question: Kunnen alle onkostenbeheersprocessen vanuit één enkele applicatie worden afgehandeld?
faq.answer: Ja. Idenfit fungeert als een complete onkostenbeheertool, waarmee je end-to-end controle hebt over voorschotten, reiskostenvergoedingen, onkostenrapporten en goedkeuringsworkflows—allemaal vanuit één dashboard.

hero.title: Time and Attendance Management
hero.text:
Regardless of the size of your company, Idenfit enables you to easily schedule your employees’ work shifts.

Idenfit helps you plan your employees’ schedules in just a few minutes and manage leave, availability, and shift change requests. You can track employees’ worked hours, avoid budget overruns and overtime, reduce absenteeism and late arrivals, and handle unexpected changes seamlessly. Idenfit’s time and attendance management module is a perfect choice for multi-location offices.

The desktop dashboard and mobile app of Idenfit allow employees to easily manage their shifts on the platform by recording their arrival and departure times respectively when they start and end their shifts. You do not need to manually enter break times; this happens automatically.

sections.title: Time Management
sections.text: With Idenfit's time and attendance management, you can manage employees' arrivals, shifts, leave, overtime, and public holidays without hassle. Idenfit ensures that shifts are calculated correctly. Well-calculated shifts help users perform performance evaluations more efficiently.

sections.title: Smart Shift Management
sections.text:
You can allow your employees to choose the shifts they want to work by scheduling available shifts for them with Idenfit’s smart shift management program. The shifts, lost hours, and breaks of your employees can be viewed and managed through a single panel. In smart shift management, shifts can be categorized as fixed, flexible, and dynamic shifts. Fixed shifts are based on specific start and end times, while flexible and dynamic shifts take the total working hours throughout the day into account.

You will receive an automatic notification if there is an issue with overtime in the weekly working hours, so you do not have to deal with such overtime repeatedly.

sections.title: Annual Calendar
sections.text: Idenfit allows you to manage the arrivals, shifts, leave, overtime, and public holidays of employees on an annual calendar for each employee individually. Data can also be edited manually. The annual calendar provides companies with detailed time and attendance data all in one dashboard where you can track your team’s habits respectively.

sections.title: Shift Calendar
sections.text:
Scheduling employee shifts on Idenfit gives you all the insights you need to plan conflict-free shifts in just a few minutes. From one platform, you can track shifts and see all shift scheduling on the calendar with a colorful and fun design. You can easily account for holidays and unavailability, avoid scheduling conflicts, and prevent overtime while staying within budget.

With Idenfit, you never have to create the same shift schedule twice. Instead, you can enjoy the flexibility of our repeat function or create templates for future use.

sections.title: Breaks
sections.text: Idenfit allows you to manage breaks during shifts flexibly, depending on the type of shift. Break data is stored and can be obtained as a report upon request. Breaks are defined and added on Idenfit according to company policy.

sections.title: Live and Historical Monitors
sections.text:
The real-time shift data of employees can be viewed on the live and historical monitors. On the live data monitor, you can view the last 10 real-time movements of the employees. The historical data monitor shows the data history that can be filtered based on personnel, date, and terminal.

At the terminals or checkpoints where authentication is required, employee photos can be taken on the Idenfit mobile app with the real-time photo capture feature. The live and historical monitors consist entirely of real-time data.

faq.question: What is time tracking and how is it calculated?
faq.answer: Time tracking refers to the system used to keep track of employees’ clock-in and clock-out times, leave, breaks, and overtime. To prepare accurate data, employees’ time data is collected and organized using time schedules, time logs, or specialized time tracking software.

faq.question: What are time schedules, time logs, and time tracking used for?
faq.answer:
Time schedules or time logs show how many hours an employee has worked within a certain period, when they were on leave, and whether they have accrued overtime.

  • Daily time tracking examples help individuals keep track.
  • Weekly or monthly time tracking lists gather data for the entire team.
  • Overtime time schedules record extended working hours and support accurate payroll processing.

faq.question: What is time tracking software and how does it work?
faq.answer: A time tracking system is a digital platform that automatically collects, organizes, and reports employees’ time data – eliminating the need for manual entry and reducing errors.

faq.question: How is employee time and attendance tracked via a time tracking system?
faq.answer: Employee time tracking includes individual records of attendance, leave, and overtime. Whether the company works with fixed shifts or rotating schedules, time tracking systems ensure accurate tracking for each employee.

faq.question: How is leave management integrated into time tracking systems?
faq.answer:
Time tracking software is integrated with leave management modules. Annual leave, sick days, unpaid leave, and holidays are automatically displayed in the time tracking records.
This ensures that reasons for absence are systematically documented, streamlines payroll processing, and provides compliant data for audits.

sections.text: Idenfit stelt u in staat om de pauzes tijdens de diensten op een flexibele manier te beheren, afhankelijk van het type dienst. sections.title: Live- en geschiedenismonitoren

De geschiedenisdatamonitor toont de gegevensgeschiedenis die kan worden gefilterd op basis van personeel, datum en terminal.

Bij de terminals of controlepunten waar authenticatie vereist is, kunnen medewerkersfoto’s worden gemaakt op de mobiele app van Idenfit met de functie voor realtime fotovangst. De live- en geschiedenisdatamonitoren bestaan volledig uit realtime gegevens.

faq.question: Wat is tijdregistratie en hoe wordt het berekend?
faq.answer: Tijdregistratie verwijst naar het systeem dat wordt gebruikt om de in- en uitkloktijden, verlof, pauzes en overuren van medewerkers bij te houden. Om nauwkeurige gegevens te kunnen voorbereiden, worden de tijdgegevens van medewerkers verzameld en georganiseerd met behulp van tijdschema’s, tijdlogs of gespecialiseerde tijdregistratiesoftware.

faq.question: Waarvoor worden tijdschema's, tijdlogs en tijdregistraties gebruikt?
faq.answer:
Tijdschema’s of tijdlogs tonen hoeveel uren een medewerker binnen een bepaalde periode heeft gewerkt, wanneer ze met verlof waren en of ze overuren hebben gemaakt.

  • Dagelijkse tijdregistratievoorbeelden helpen individuen bij te houden.
  • Wekelijkse of maandelijkse tijdregistratielijsten verzamelen gegevens voor het hele team.
  • Overuren tijdschema’s registreren verlengde werktijden en ondersteunen nauwkeurige salarisverwerking.

faq.question: Wat is een tijdregistratiesoftware en hoe werkt het?
faq.answer: Een tijdregistratiesysteem is een digitaal platform dat automatisch tijdgegevens van medewerkers verzamelt, organiseert en rapporteert – waardoor de noodzaak voor handmatige registratie wordt geëlimineerd en fouten worden verminderd.

faq.question: Hoe wordt de tijd en aanwezigheid van medewerkers gevolgd via een tijdregistratiesysteem?
faq.answer: Tijdregistratie van medewerkers omvat individuele registraties van aanwezigheid, verlof en overuren. Of het bedrijf nu werkt met vaste diensten of roterende schema’s, tijdregistratiesystemen zorgen voor nauwkeurige tracking voor elke werknemer.

faq.question: Hoe is verlofbeheer geïntegreerd in tijdregistratiesystemen?
faq.answer:
Tijdregistratiesoftware is geïntegreerd met verlofbeheermodules. Jaarlijks verlof, ziektedagen, onbetaald verlof en feestdagen worden automatisch weergegeven in de tijdregistraties.
Dit zorgt ervoor dat afwezigheidsredenen systematisch worden gedocumenteerd, stroomlijnt de salarisverwerking en biedt conforme gegevens voor audits.

faq.question: What is time tracking and how is it calculated?
faq.answer: Time tracking refers to the system used to keep track of employees’ clock-in and clock-out times, leave, breaks, and overtime. To prepare accurate data, employees’ time data is collected and organized using time schedules, time logs, or specialized time tracking software.

faq.question: What are time schedules, time logs, and time tracking used for?
faq.answer:
Time schedules or time logs show how many hours an employee has worked within a certain period, when they were on leave, and whether they have accrued overtime.

  • Daily time tracking examples help individuals keep track.
  • Weekly or monthly time tracking lists gather data for the entire team.
  • Overtime time schedules record extended working hours and support accurate payroll processing.

faq.question: What is time tracking software and how does it work?
faq.answer: A time tracking system is a digital platform that automatically collects, organizes, and reports employees’ time data – eliminating the need for manual entry and reducing errors.

faq.question: How is employee time and attendance tracked via a time tracking system?
faq.answer: Employee time tracking includes individual records of attendance, leave, and overtime. Whether the company works with fixed shifts or rotating schedules, time tracking systems ensure accurate tracking for each employee.

faq.question: How is leave management integrated into time tracking systems?
faq.answer:
Time tracking software is integrated with leave management modules. Annual leave, sick days, unpaid leave, and holidays are automatically displayed in the time tracking records.
This ensures that reasons for absence are systematically documented, streamlines payroll processing, and provides compliant data for audits.
